title: Business CRM
summary: A multi-module business system where customers, contracts, orders, invoices and settlements all run on one shared framework.
description:
Built from scratch to show the kind of system I worked on for an agricultural cooperative, with a generic domain and fake data.

- One shared list, detail and edit framework drives every module.
- A settlement module computes amounts from deliveries, prices, deductions and advances, with thorough tests.
- PDF invoices and settlements, roles and an audit log.
